conditions: The discovered history changes a route, risk estimate, relationship, hypothesis, counter, or resource decision.
The environment remains interpretable without reading every optional text.
Mechanical consequence does not certify the player's interpretation as true.
effect: Story discovery becomes part of play rather than a detached archive collected between decisions.
failure_boundary: If removing every narrative trace changes only completion percentage and reading time, the environmental story is not integrated with the current playable system.
